3.name: Combat Superiority
3.notes:
Your experience on the battlefield has refined your fighting techniques. You learn maneuvers fueled by Superiority Dice.

Maneuvers. You learn three maneuvers of your choice from the Maneuver Options list. You can use only one maneuver per attack. You learn two additional maneuvers at levels 7, 10, and 15. Each time you learn new maneuvers, you may replace one maneuver you know.

Superiority Dice. You have four d8 Superiority Dice. They are expended when used and restored on a Short or Long Rest. You gain additional dice at levels 7 (five dice) and 15 (six dice).

Saving Throws. If a maneuver requires a saving throw, the DC equals 8 + your Strength or Dexterity modifier (your choice) + your Proficiency Bonus.

3.name: Student of War
3.notes: You gain proficiency with one type of Artisan's Tools of your choice, and proficiency in one skill of your choice from the Fighter level 1 skill list.

7.name: Know Your Enemy
7.notes: As a Bonus Action, you learn whether a creature within 30 feet has Immunities, Resistances, or Vulnerabilities, and what they are. Once used, it can't be used again until a Long Rest, unless you expend a Superiority Die to restore a use (no action required).

10.name: Improved Combat Superiority
10.notes: Your Superiority Die becomes a d10.

15.name: Relentless
15.notes: Once per turn, when you use a maneuver, you can roll 1d8 and use the number rolled instead of expending a Superiority Die.

18.name: Ultimate Combat Superiority
18.notes: Your Superiority Die becomes a d12.
